completeSourceCards.name: Covering Fire
completeSourceCards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack. On hit normal damage and target has-2 on its next attack against an ally other than you. Further Covering Fire replaces rather than stacks this penalty.

source.originalText: Covering Fire: Fire a volley that forces enemies in a line to take cover or suffer damage.

completeSourceCards.name: Tactical Reposition
completeSourceCards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Requires an open route; no teleporting, escaping restraints or attacks.

source.originalText: Tactical Reposition: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

completeSourceCards.name: Brutal Strike
completeSourceCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
completeSourceCards.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
completeSourceCards.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

source.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

completeSourceCards.name: Quick Shot
completeSourceCards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack, dealing weapon die only without ability damage modifier. Does not trigger Extra Attack or another Quick Shot; may gain one Hit Chain point at 11 within the turn cap.

source.originalText: Quick Shot: Fire a rapid arrow that deals less damage but can be used as part of another action.

completeSourceCards.name: Twin Strike
completeSourceCards.rangeAndTarget: One or 2 enemies in melee reach; two light weapons wielded
completeSourceCards.effect: Make one attack with each weapon. Add ability modifier to first hit only. These are the full attacks for this Action; do not add ordinary Extra Attack. Hit Chain gains at 11 cap 2 per turn.

source.originalText: Twin Strike: Make a swift attack with both melee weapons when dual wielding.

completeSourceCards.name: Nature's Whisper
completeSourceCards.effect: Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

source.originalText: Nature's Whisper: Cast a minor nature spell that reveals hidden creatures or tracks within a small area.

completeSourceCards.name: Skirmisher's Step
completeSourceCards.effect: Move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Supplied movement does not increase remaining normal movement. Requires an unblocked route; no teleport or escape from restraints.

source.originalText: Skirmisher's Step: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

completeSourceCards.name: Cunning Movement
completeSourceCards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks; may pass through hostile occupied squares but not end there. Cannot cross impassable terrain or escape restraints.

source.originalText: Cunning Movement: Move through hostile-occupied tiles without provoking opportunity attacks.

completeSourceCards.name: Disable Device
completeSourceCards.frequency: At will; retries need changed approach
completeSourceCards.effect: Make DEX+PB against its stated disarm DC; unknown DC defaults 15 for ordinary trap, 20 complex. Success disarms one accessible mechanism, failure by 5 triggers it. Does not automatically dispel magic.

source.originalText: Disable Device: Disarm non-magical traps, pressure plates, or poison glyphs.

completeSourceCards.name: Feint
completeSourceCards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 10 ft that perceives you
completeSourceCards.effect: CHA or DEX+PB deception check against target passive Insight. Success grants advantage on your next weapon attack against it. Failure gives no bonus; no mind-control or guaranteed critical.

source.originalText: Feint: Distract an opponent, giving you advantage on your next attack against them.

completeSourceCards.name: Shadow Step
completeSourceCards.effect: Move half Speed and attempt Hide if the destination can conceal you. Movement produces no deliberate footfall noise but normal senses still apply. This Base feature is not teleportation.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Move half your speed without making sound or leaving tracks.

completeSourceCards.name: Flurry of Blows
completeSourceCards.rangeAndTarget: One or two creatures within your unarmed reach
completeSourceCards.effect: Flurry of Blows. Tags: base, active, attack, ki. Make exactly two separate unarmed strikes. The first successful Flurry strike on your turn grants 1 Ki. If both strikes hit different creatures, the second may grant 1 additional Ki, subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Tiger critical generation and Flowing Form may occur, but the total Ki gained on your turn still cannot exceed 2.

source.originalText: Flurry of Blows: Deliver a rapid sequence of unarmed strikes, with each hit having a chance to generate Ki Chain.

completeFeatContract.name: Versatile Mastery

originalObject.name: Versatile Mastery
originalObject.description: Racial feat tied to Human heritage.
originalObject.effect: Once per rest, use a class skill or ability from another party member.

completeFeatContract.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
completeFeatContract.completeOperativeProcedure: Require actual Human heritage. NEW once per completed beneficialSR orLR, borrow one permitted class skill for one check OR one class ability activation from a real willing current party member. Before use, spend one uninterrupted minute together within5ft communicating through an actual shared language/channel; choose the exact currently acquired donor skill/card and record donor consent. This preparation changes no resources and does not spend the use; one prepared choice at a time, ending at the next completedrest or replacement. Donor must have it through actual class training/acquisition, not a copied, borrowed or suppressed grant; you must meet actual body/equipment and the menu's total-level gate. You may then consume the feat use on your own legal check/activation while donor is conscious within30ft and can perceive/understand your signal; donor spends noAction, use or resource. A skill choice uses your own ability+normalPB for one real check, replacing lower proficiency, never donor ability, expertise or passive bonus; the task must actually use that donor's class-granted skill. An ability choice uses one of the twelve exact permitted cards/procedures below, your own stats/PB/materials and actual activation cost. These finite NEW borrowing limits deliberately narrow the source's otherwise unbounded class-ability promise for joint decision. No extra feat use after failure, no copied class levels/engines, passive/Arch/Hero/finale ability, transformation, companion, summon, item production, resource generation, permanent learning or further borrowing. The menu grants a one-use ability permission, never its independent class resource pool; actual1RP cost must be paid from your existing personal legalRPpool. Shared spell/Weave restrictions still apply where printed. An already-known same card shares its own recharge/use ledger, so borrowing cannot bypass a spent natural entitlement; an unknown menu card gets only this one borrowed activation and its future recharge history is retained. Existing ordinary resources and restrictions persist after the temporary permission ends. Lasting riders keep their original deadlines and source identity, with you as actor and donor provenance retained.

scope: Paid Human feat, real first-class training and earned opportunity, source-valid donor selections; bounded preparation/consent/range/payment, all12 native borrowed effects and skill alternative under explicitly conditional encounter facts.
limitations: Donor selections follow actual level1 schedules; party/consent, physical bodies/items/ammunition/tools, geometry, completed uninterrupted work and clock identities remain stated test-world facts, not authenticated campaign records.

Conditional personal same-card prior-use histories exercise shared counters; this is not a full natural class-card activation or rest/time engine. No multiclass, class-selection advancement or respec procedure is inferred.

Damage is native before passive defenses, damage packet/Wounds/healing and independent actually-owned riders. Borrowing itself creates no class resources; existing separate feature triggers remain outside this slice.

Movement is one-dimensional with declared actual route segments. Shadow Hide is a bounded immediate paired operation; arbitrary interleaving, global stealth observations and opportunity-attack resolution are not implemented.

Nature Whisper positive use assumes independently valid minor-Weave clearance and a sourced personal Bard RP pool; full Weave/Dissonance, casting interruption and component integration are still separate obligations.

Feint and Covering Fire riders preserve source/endpoint, but their later actual attack consumption and nonstacking arbitration are not yet executed. Full FXC04/07/08/09 closure and complete feat approval are not claimed.
